info.title: ComiGo Mobile API
info.description:
Single client contract for the ComiGo unified mobile application, which contains both the passenger and driver experience on one account.

Supersedes passenger-app.openapi.json and driver-app.openapi.json (Decision 011).

The /api/v1/passenger/** and /api/v1/driver/** namespaces are retained: they are role-scoped resource namespaces, not app boundaries. Mode is a client concept; the server authorises on role, resource ownership and gate state.

Every operation carries an `x-routeshare-status` extension:
  IMPLEMENTED      - live in apps/api today
  PLANNED_SLICE_NN - specified, to be built in that slice of the ComiGo backend plan
  CUT              - deliberately removed from the product, with a reason

Plan: docs/development/implementation/tasks/comigo-unified-app-backend/

AlternativeTrip.description: P13, P22, P24. An empty list is a real answer — offering nothing beats offering a trip nine hours away dressed as an alternative.

AppContextActiveTrip.description: Drives the resume bar on P01b and D08b, and the mode-switch sheets S10/S11.

supportReadable.description: Always true; tells both participants that support can read the thread.

AppContextBadges.description: Tab badge rules per board S14. Home and Account are dots; Trips and Inbox are counts; the action tab is never badged.

AppContextGate.description: A reason the caller cannot do something, as data the app renders (S07-S13, D34, D40).

AppContextResponse.description: Everything the ComiGo app shell needs on cold start and after a mode switch, in one call. Fields owned by later slices return safe zero values until those slices land, so the shell never has to reshape.

AppliedDues.description: What this checkout carried over from an earlier trip (P09d). Dues are added to the total; they never block a booking.

totalDue.description: fareEstimate plus any dues this checkout carried over (P09d)

appliedDuesAmount.description: What this booking carried over, kept on the booking so a receipt read months later still shows the line

appliedCredit.description: Shared rewards credit applied to this fare; never exceeds estimatedFare.

rewardsBalance.description: Remaining shared rewards balance after this booking.

seats.description: The named slots this booking holds

expiresAt.description: When an unanswered request lapses (D16); null once confirmed

BookingPayment.description: What has actually happened to this booking's money. P11 says authorised-not-charged, P12 states the exact capture time, P22 and P24 say never charged — all three read this block.

capturedAt.description: The minute the card was actually charged. Null until the trip starts.

paymentMethodId.description: The card to hold the fare on. Omit for cash: nothing is authorised and the driver collects in the car.

CancellationTerms.description: The single source both P26 and P34 read. The client never decides whether a cancel is free.

penaltyPct.description: What would apply if she cancels anyway

recordedAgainstPassenger.description: A free cancel unlocked by a late driver does not

fareBase.description: The fare the percentage is taken of

penaltyAmount.description: The rule, priced — P26 never has to work out 20% of a fare shown on another screen

penaltyVictimShare.description: Her driver's half, which P26 names explicitly

penaltyPlatformShare.description: ComiGo's half; the two always re-add to penaltyAmount

CounterpartyContact.description: Plan §6.1. Disclosed only on a confirmed booking, reciprocally, withdrawn 24 h after drop-off and immediately on any terminal state. Every read is audited. The emergency numbers are static and never subject to these rules.

role.description: Whose number this is: DRIVER | PASSENGER

paymentMethodId.description: The card to hold the fare on. Omit for cash: nothing is authorised and the driver collects in the car.

seatSlotIds.description: Chosen slots (P08). Omit to let the server take the lowest free ones.

useRewardsCredit.description: Explicit checkout opt-in/out. Null uses the account auto-apply setting.

vehicleClass.description: Drives the seat cap (D07) and the range the band must sit inside.

DriverReinstatementRequest.description: A deactivated driver's request to be reinstated (board D34). Only one may be open at a time.

onTimeStartPct.description: null when there were no opportunities — not 0%

missedStartDetail.description: D34 shows the misses themselves; a count cannot answer 'which three?'

DrivingPreferences.description: D35. canSetWomenOnly is false unless this driver's own NIC verifies her as female; the client hides the toggle rather than offering one that always fails.

DrivingPreferencesRequest.description: All six move together. A partial update would let a client that has never heard of a newer preference silently reset it.

trip.description: Origin → destination of the trip it came from

method.description: How the original fare was to be paid; dues only ever arise on cash

Dues.description: P25 and P25b. `settled` carries the empty state explicitly: "nothing owed" and "nothing loaded" must not render the same.

EarlyDropAllowance.description: P16 / P16b. Exhaustion is data, not an error: the third drop still releases the seat.

fareAdjusted.description: False once the monthly allowance is spent

allowanceReasonCode.description: EARLY_DROP_ALLOWANCE_EXHAUSTED when the fare was not adjusted

EligibilityImpact.description: D35's cost line. Counted from real refusals, including the ones search made silently.

actionPath.description: Where the app should send the user to clear the refusal. Populated on gated 403s and 409s; null otherwise.

FareQuote.description: A priced ride, with every line the fare screens draw so no client does arithmetic on money. The commission comes OUT of what the passenger pays, never on top: driverNet + commissionAmount == passengerPays always holds, and is enforced by a database constraint. commissionAmount and driverNet are omitted on passenger surfaces.

onRouteDistanceMeters.description: Server-derived from the matched substring of the driver's route line.

ratePerKm.description: The vehicle's own chosen rate inside its assessed band.

policyVersion.description: Fingerprint of the pricing rules in force when this was quoted.

sampleId.description: Device-generated idempotency identifier, unique within the trip.

counterparty.description: Visible only inside the open privacy-bounded approach session.

OccurrenceCancellationTerms.description: D30, before he commits. The window is routing's rule; the money is the penalty engine's arithmetic.

affectedRiderFirstNames.description: First names only — D31 names them without disclosing anything else

OccurrenceEditability.description: D09. Computed from the occurrence's status and its live seat holds, never stored.

PassengerVerification.description: P28 and P31a-c. blocksBooking is always false and is returned anyway: P31a promises a rider may book, pay and ride as normal at any level, and a client that infers that from a missing field will eventually infer it wrongly.

Penalty.description: One broken promise, priced and split. Every figure P26, P27, D21, D30, D31 and D41 name is here, so no screen has to derive one and risk deriving it differently from the ledger.

fareBase.description: The fare, or the driver's expected net, the percentage was taken of

victimShare.description: Always re-adds to feeAmount with platformShare

amountForViewer.description: Negative when this penalty charged the caller, positive when it paid them — D26 renders both from one list

disputable.description: False once the 48-hour window closes, or once one has been raised

PenaltyBeneficiary.description: Named by first name only. D31 tells a driver his fee reached "Dinuka and Tharindu"; a surname or a contact detail would turn a fee notice into a disclosure.

amount.description: This person's part of the victim half, in whole rupees

PhotoVisibility.description: P30. Resolved server-side on every read; a HIDDEN photo URL is never emitted anywhere, not even for a client to ignore.

PickupPoint.description: Where to actually stand. source is returned because it is operationally load-bearing: the cost model depends on CURATED and DERIVED dominating and Places being a last resort, and a hit rate you cannot see is one you cannot defend.

sideHint.description: Kerb side, opposite the pharmacy - the half a coordinate cannot carry.

PickupWait.description: D19 / D19b from the driver's side and P38 / P38b from hers — the same clock.

arrivedAt.description: Detected GPS arrival, never a driver tap

releasableNow.description: Server-decided; a driver must not be able to release early

RateBand.description: The band ComiGo assessed and the rate the driver chose inside it (D39, D39b, D39c, D40). A driver never types a price; they pick a point in this range.

setBy.description: Always "ComiGo" — the assessing admin is never named to the driver.

RateBandFactor.description: One line of the arithmetic on D39. Typed by an admin as justification; never an input the band was computed from.

RatePositionOption.description: Where a rate sits in the band and what that costs in visibility. Copy, not a ranking multiplier — the server applies no such thing.

RideSearchPage.description: filteredOutByRadius is computed in the same statement as the results. A silently short list reads as 'no drivers', which is a different and much worse message than '6 more drivers start further than 20 km away'.

RideSearchRequest.description: radiusKm is measured from the driver's trip ORIGIN, not from how close his route passes the rider. Only the offered values are accepted - an unoffered radius is refused rather than clamped, because clamping answers a question the rider did not ask.

RideSearchResult.description: One P04 card, complete. The client does no arithmetic: every figure here is computed once, server-side, from the same inputs that will price the booking. startsKmAway is a distance and originLabel is a place name - the driver's actual origin coordinate is never emitted, because for most drivers it is their home.

RouteFareEstimateRequest.description: Locates a rider's pickup and drop-off along a published trip's route line. No distance, rate or fare may be sent — every pricing input is server-derived.

SeatMap.description: P08's seat picker. There is no price per slot and there never will be — every seat costs the same, and a field for it here is the first step towards a screen that lies.

StartWindow.description: D32 / D32b / D32c. The client renders a countdown and a consequence; it computes neither.

expiresAt.description: Deadline in force now; the extension moved it or it did not

extensionsRemaining.description: 0 or 1 — D32c disables the button rather than failing on tap

consequence.description: What happens at zero, in words the screen shows unchanged

TripShareCode.description: D14. Ten base32 characters, about fifty bits - unguessable rather than merely unique, because the code is pasted into group chats.

TripStartCapture.description: One booking's outcome when the trip started. A declined card does not stop the trip: the driver is at the wheel and the other passengers are in the car.

failureCode.description: A safe code only; the provider's own wording never leaves the server.

who.description: First name plus surname initial only.

referralCode.description: One-time immutable referral attribution, accepted only during signup.

UsualCommute.description: P02. The match count runs the ordinary search over the saved pair, so the number on the dashboard and the list it opens cannot disagree.

bandStatus.description: D06 shows this per vehicle: approved papers with no band still cannot carry a trip.

VehicleClass.description: A class of vehicle: what it may carry, and the range its per-km band must sit inside.

VerificationCaptureUploadRequest.description: captureSource and capturedAt are an attestation recorded for the human reviewer, not a proof. A client can lie about both, which is why review stays human.

VerificationStep.description: P29. Label, hint and guide shape travel with the step so the copy a rider reads and the step a reviewer decides on cannot drift apart.
